about: Supriya Lifescience is engaged in the manufacturing of Active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs). As of March 31, 2021, the company produces 38 APIs focused on diverse therapeutic segments such as antihistamine, analgesic, anaesthetic, vitamin, anti-asthmatic and anti-allergic. [1]
